name: Egao no Riyuu
source:
April -- a time of meetings. My dad's job transfer has sent the two of us to a new town, and me specifically to a new school. A new place is a chance for a new start, so I'm going to try and get myself my ideal girlfriend! I might be getting my hopes up, here, but it's good to dream big! 
What kind of wonderful encounters might await me at this new school?
My heart beating in my chest, the curtain opens on my fresh new life.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE269227.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
四月，是邂逅的季节。爸爸工作调动，我们一起搬到了新城镇，而我也转入了一所新学校。新的地方意味着新的开始，所以我要努力找到理想的女朋友！也许我期待得有点多，但人总该怀抱远大的梦想！

在这所新学校里，会有什么美妙的邂逅等待着我？

心脏在胸腔中砰砰跳动，我全新生活的帷幕拉开了。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE269227.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
